description.en: Automagik's plugins for DeepSeek Harness, each at its product's version: Omni's team, channels, canvases and welcome, and the vetted ways to bring your own AI.

title.en: Personal use under the vendor's terms

description.en: Omni's Bot team in DSH: the Main Bot and its Bots, sessions, memory and settings. Add Omni channels to link your Omni, and Omni canvases for live UI.
Link your Omni with a QR and your own WhatsApp: its channels and chats in DSH, the Omni Bot operating them, and automations on its events. Needs the Bot team.
The Omni Bot shows what it found as live UI in the chat, drawn from your Omni. Needs the Bot team and Omni channels.
The Omni octopus welcomes you and connects your AI: DeepSeek, an API key, Codex, Claude, Kimi or a CLIProxyAPI gateway, through DSH's own sign-ins.
Use a ChatGPT or Codex plan through DSH's own Codex sign-in.
The official Claude Code CLI as a model provider.
A Kimi Code membership through a dedicated model route. Its own update button can move past this vetted version.
OpenCode Go with its settings page. DSH's built-in opencode-go route covers basic use.

Sign in with the AI plans you already pay for, several accounts each: Antigravity, Cursor, Kiro, GLM, Qwen, ERNIE, Spark, JetBrains AI, Perplexity, Replit and Cody. Automagik's reviewed fork of GooDAnDReaDY's plugin, without the vendors DSH's own sign-ins already cover and without its own updater.

A team of long-lived Bots in DSH: the Main Bot and its Bots, group chats, memory and settings. Omni's channels and canvases build on it. Keeps its files in ~/.automagik/bots, never in your DSH profile. Formerly @automagik/omni-dsh (Omni team).

The octopus welcomes you, puts your team together and connects your AI: DeepSeek, an API key, Codex, Claude, Kimi or a CLIProxyAPI gateway, through DSH's own sign-ins. Formerly @automagik/omni-ai-dsh.
Genie joins your Bot team and grants wishes: each wish is a Task that works in its own git worktree of your project and commits the result on a wish/… branch. Needs the Bot team and git.

Use the models of your own DSH in Unfold, and let Unfold follow the agents you pick. Serves your DSH's model routes to apps on this computer as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on 127.0.0.1, behind a key made at each start. Unfold sees your sessions' names and status, and what your agents say only for the sessions you subscribe it to. It can draft a next message for an agent, which is sent only when you click Send in DSH. Your sign-ins and their tokens stay in DSH. It never answers approvals and runs no tools.
